info.title: Moon Card Issuing API
info.description:
Moon's API enables you to issue Visa Cards and purchase branded gift cards for your customers.

We offer a simple API for Visa cards to:
 - create cards
 - fetch a card and its associated information
 - add a balance to a card (if reloadable)
 - get the transaction history for a card
 - create and remove webhook endpoints that will receive notifications of events (e.g. card transactions, deposits)
 - add funds to your account
 - simulate card transactions (sandbox only)

Example:

1) Create a card C. It has $0 balance to start.
2) Send 10,000 USDC to our USDC wallet. Moon Reserve is $10,000.
3) Add $1000 balance to card C. Moon Reserve is now $9,000. Cardholder may now spend up to $1000 on card C.

For branded gift cards we offer:
 - View list of available branded gift card products
 - purchase branded gift cards
 - mark a branded gift card as used or unused

The API currently supports the following funding sources: BTC and USDC via Polygon

post.description:
This endpoint only works in sandbox.

 This endpoint enables you to simulate a transaction for the specified card. You can set the transaction amount, currency, merchant name and merchant country code.
 
 The transaction type must be one of the following:
 AUTHORIZATION,
 REVERSAL,
 CLEARING,
 REFUND. 
 
 Example:
 
 AUTHORIZATION 10 USD. => this will trigger an authorization webhook that contains a transaction ID that must be used in the following simulation requests.
 
 REVERSAL 2 USD. => this will simulate reversing $2 of the authorization.
 
 CLEARING 8 USD. => this will simulate setting the remaining $8.
 
 REFUND 8 USD. => this will simulate refunding the $8.
